name: Develop a social media strategy
description: Define positioning and content pillars, develop ideas and create a publishing plan.
input:
SYNTHETIC SAMPLE DATA – entirely fictional, for trying things out only.

Creator: "Cooking with Kim" (fictional), Instagram 8,400 followers, TikTok 3,100 followers, no YouTube channel
Content so far: quick after-work recipes, irregularly 1–2 posts per week
Best posts: 15-minute pasta (reel, 92,000 views), meal prep for the week (carousel, 1,400 saves)
Audience according to statistics: aged 25–40, mostly working, 70 % women
Goal in three months: 15,000 followers on Instagram and a first collaboration with a regional brand
Time: about 6 hours per week for planning, filming and editing
Start date of the plan: Monday, 2026-05-04

guide.problem: Publishing regularly needs a clear direction and a plan that fits your own time budget. The workflow derives a strategy from the metrics, collects suitable ideas and plans publication.
guide.flow: A chain of three agents: the strategy agent sets positioning, content pillars and goals and evaluates attached statistics for this, the idea developer formulates concrete post ideas with a hook, and the content planner spreads them over four weeks. The idea developer remembers its suggestions in a memory so that later runs do not repeat ideas. A quality check verifies that frequency and mix are realistic.
guide.input: Profile with platforms, figures, successful posts, audience, goals, available time and start date. You can also attach statistics as screenshots or as a CSV/Excel export; the sample file is such an export.
guide.result: A four-week content plan with date, platform, format, idea, hook and call to action, introduced by a short summary of the strategy, also as an Excel file for further planning.
guide.adapt: Enter your profile and figures or attach screenshots of your statistics. Add your brand style and no-go topics in the system prompt of the idea developer. You can find the memory “creator-ideas” under Memory; clear it if you want to start afresh. For a monthly plan you can run the copy on a schedule.
guide.control: Automatic: the idea developer reads the memory “creator-ideas” before it starts and, at the end of every run, saves the working titles of its new ideas there itself, without a confirmation step; you can view or clear the memory under Memory. A quality check by a second model reads the content planner's calendar against three criteria (frequency fits the time budget, pillars balanced, goals supported); if one fails, the calendar is revised once and the check result is recorded with the run. No step waits for a person and no own budget is set (your workspace's default budget applies). Nothing is published: the plan is a draft that you adjust and post yourself.
guide.why: Strategy, ideas and calendar build strictly on each other, so a chain of three agents is enough; the content planner also gets the strategy directly so it can check the mix against the pillars. Memory sits only on the idea developer, because repeated ideas are the real problem with monthly runs, while the strategy should be derived afresh from current figures. Deliberately not used: live web search for trends and a connection to the platforms, because trend results change daily and would make runs neither reproducible nor portable, and because a draft plan should not be posted automatically; the strategy rests on your own statistics instead.

strategy.name: Strategy agent
strategy.description: Defines positioning, content pillars and measurable goals.
strategy.system: You are a social media strategist for creators. From the metrics and goals, derive a one-sentence positioning, three to four content pillars with their share, suitable formats per platform and measurable goals for three months. Justify every decision with the available data and take the time budget into account.
strategy.task:
Develop the strategy for this profile:

{{run.input}}

ideas.name: Idea developer
ideas.description: Develops concrete post ideas with hook and format.
ideas.system: You are a creative content developer. For each content pillar, develop four concrete post ideas with a working title, format, a hook for the first three seconds and a call to action. Aim for variety and for ideas that can be produced with little effort. Mark ideas that suit a brand collaboration. Use your memory: before developing ideas, read which ideas were already proposed in earlier runs and avoid repeating them. At the end, save the working titles of the new ideas with the date. If the memory is empty, simply start afresh.
ideas.task:
Develop post ideas for this strategy:

{{node:strategy}}

calendar.name: Content planner
calendar.description: Spreads the ideas over a realistic four-week plan.
calendar.system: You plan content calendars. Start with a three-sentence summary of the strategy. Then create a plan for four weeks from the start date as a table with date, weekday, platform, format, idea, hook and call to action. Plan production so that it fits the time budget, for example with filming days for several posts.

criteria.realistic_frequency: The publishing frequency fits the stated time budget.
criteria.pillars_balanced: The content pillars are distributed according to the strategy.
criteria.matches_goals: The plan visibly supports the stated goals.

insights.label: Statistics
insights.description: Optional: screenshots of your statistics (PNG, JPEG, WebP) or an export as CSV or Excel, up to 6 files. Without files, the figures in the text apply.

insights.description: A fictional statistics export with seven posts as CSV.
